categories.main_business_segments: China Reinsurance (Group) Corporation operates primarily in property and casualty (P&C) reinsurance, life and health reinsurance, primary P&C insurance, asset management, and insurance intermediary services. The Group conducts domestic and overseas operations through subsidiaries such as China Re P&C, China Re Life, China Continent Insurance, China Re AMC, and Huatai Insurance Agency.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced catastrophe models, digital transformation technologies including artificial intelligence, big data, blockchain, and cloud computing to enhance underwriting, risk management, and product innovation. It also employs sophisticated asset-liability management and risk control systems, and has developed proprietary catastrophe risk models like the China Re Catastrophe model and China Flood Catastrophe Model 2.0.
categories.primary_customers_markets: China Re serves a broad range of clients including domestic and international insurance companies, financial institutions, and government entities. Its markets cover P&C insurers, life and health insurers, micro, small and medium-sized enterprises, and individual policyholders, with a focus on national strategies such as green energy, technology innovation, inclusive finance, and catastrophe insurance.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group operates primarily in China, with significant overseas presence through subsidiaries and branches in Hong Kong, Singapore, the UK, Ireland, and Australia. It actively participates in international markets via entities like Chaucer and China Re UK, and supports the Belt and Road Initiative through cross-border insurance and reinsurance services.
categories.supply_chain_position: China Re operates mainly as a reinsurer and primary insurer, positioning itself midstream and downstream in the insurance supply chain. It provides reinsurance protection to primary insurers and also offers primary insurance products directly to end customers, complemented by asset management and insurance intermediary services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The Group’s strategic priorities include building a world-class comprehensive reinsurance group with sustainable development capabilities, advancing digital transformation, enhancing underwriting and investment profitability, and deepening global development. R&D focuses on catastrophe risk modeling, digital and AI-driven underwriting, product innovation in health, green, and technology insurance, and integration of insurance with health and pension services.
categories.revenue_model: China Re generates revenue primarily through gross written premiums from reinsurance and primary insurance products. Additional income streams include investment income from asset management activities, fees from insurance intermediary services, and returns from equity investments and associates.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: China Re is the leading domestic reinsurance group in China, holding the largest market share in P&C and life and health reinsurance. It competes with both domestic and international reinsurers and insurers, leveraging its state-owned status, extensive client base, and technological capabilities to maintain a dominant and influential market position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2024, China Re reported total assets of RMB 508.3 billion and net profit of RMB 11.08 billion, reflecting year-on-year growth of approximately 10.6% in assets and 91.3% in net profit. The Group’s gross written premiums reached RMB 101.36 billion, with steady growth across segments. It maintains strong solvency ratios and international credit ratings, demonstrating robust financial health and a positive growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: China Re emphasizes prudence and innovation to provide high-quality, comprehensive reinsurance and insurance solutions that support national strategies and economic stability. Its unique value lies in its extensive domestic market leadership, integration of advanced catastrophe modeling and digital technologies, diversified product offerings including specialized insurance for emerging risks, and strong risk management capabilities that deliver stable underwriting profits and investment returns.
